text_blocks.snippet: The pathology report would indicate axillary lymph node spread of the primary breast cancer. After a mastectomy, if lymph nodes are biopsied and found to contain cancer cells, it means the cancer has spread to those specific nodes. Specifically, the report would indicate the number of positive axillary lymph nodes, as was the case with Sharon's biopsy.
